title: Hepatocyte DDIT4 aggravates MASH progression through GPX4-mediated ferroptosis.
authors: Wang, Huiying; Liu, Wen-Yue; Zhang, Feng; Chen, Wei; Hu, Jinying; Cheng, Ruitang; Chen, Zhinan; Wu, Dan; Xie, Lijun; Tao, Yongguang; Zheng, Ming-Hua; Hu, Fang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究肝细胞DDIT4通过GPX4介导铁死亡促进MASH进展，虽含分子对接但核心为疾病机制与铁死亡，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND & AIMS: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH) is a progressive liver disease with limited therapeutic options, and the role of ferroptosis in its pathogenesis remains to be fully understood. In this study, we aimed to investigate the action of DNA damage-inducible transcript 4 (DDIT4) in the ferroptosis and regulation of MASH progression. METHODS: The Gene Expression Omnibus database of MASH mice models and ferroptosis database were used to identify crucial ferroptosis related genes in MASH. Hepatic DDIT4 expression was detected in MASH patients, mouse models and hepatocytes. The functional role of DDIT4 was assessed in different diet-induced MASH mice models with hepatocyte-specific DDIT4 overexpression or knockout. RNA-sequencing and immunoprecipitation-mass spectrometry (IP-MS) were performed to determine DDIT4 interacting proteins. Molecular docking was used to explore the potential compound targeting DDIT4. RESULTS: We have discovered significantly elevated DDIT4 levels in mice and patients with MASH, which were positively correlated with MASH severity. Hepatocyte-specific over-expression of DDIT4 aggravated ferroptosis and MASH progression, while DDIT4 deletion alleviated ferroptosis and MASH progression. Mechanistically, DDIT4 decreased glutathione peroxidase 4 (GPX4) expression in an mTORC1 dependent manner. Additionally, DDIT4 interacted with cytosolic GPX4 and inhibited TOM22-mediated mitochondrial translocation, resulting in mitochondrial GPX4 reduction and ferroptosis activation. Importantly, through molecular docking and surface plasmon resonance (SPR), we have identified quercetagetin, a natural flavonoid, as a potential DDIT4-targeting compound. Administration of quercetagetin alleviated hepatic steatosis, inflammation, and fibrosis in MASH mice. CONCLUSIONS: Our study establishes the DDIT4-GPX4-ferroptosis axis as a new regulatory node in MASH progression and highlights DDIT4 as a potential therapeutic target for MASH.
abstract_zh: 背景与目的：代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝炎（MASH）是一种进行性肝病，治疗选择有限，铁死亡（ferroptosis）在其发病机制中的作用尚未完全阐明。本研究旨在探讨DNA损伤诱导转录因子4（DDIT4）在铁死亡及MASH进展调控中的作用。方法：利用MASH小鼠模型的基因表达综合（Gene Expression Omnibus）数据库和铁死亡数据库，识别MASH中关键的铁死亡相关基因。在MASH患者、小鼠模型及肝细胞中检测肝组织DDIT4表达。通过肝细胞特异性DDIT4过表达或敲除的不同饮食诱导MASH小鼠模型，评估DDIT4的功能作用。采用RNA测序和免疫沉淀-质谱（IP-MS）确定DDIT4相互作用蛋白。利用分子对接探索靶向DDIT4的潜在化合物。结果：我们发现MASH小鼠和患者中DDIT4水平显著升高，且与MASH严重程度呈正相关。肝细胞特异性过表达DDIT4加重铁死亡和MASH进展，而DDIT4缺失则缓解铁死亡和MASH进展。机制上，DDIT4以mTORC1依赖性方式降低谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶4（GPX4）表达。此外，DDIT4与胞质GPX4相互作用，抑制TOM22介导的线粒体转位，导致线粒体GPX4减少和铁死亡激活。重要的是，通过分子对接和表面等离子体共振（SPR），我们鉴定出天然黄酮类化合物槲皮万寿菊素（quercetagetin）为潜在的DDIT4靶向化合物。给予槲皮万寿菊素可减轻MASH小鼠的肝脂肪变性、炎症和纤维化。结论：本研究确立了DDIT4-GPX4-铁死亡轴作为MASH进展的新调控节点，并强调DDIT4是MASH的潜在治疗靶点。
